title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - ServiceTest
description: A service test is an entity that exists for a controlled test invocation on a service. The service test is executed according to a schedule and contains service test configuration parameters that are to be applied at execution time, and service test measures that result. (TM Forum TMF653 Service Test Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component ServiceTest; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ServiceTest'

AppliedConsequence.description: An Applied Consequence defines the action (prescribed action or notification) to take when a MeasureThresholdRuleViolation occurs.

appliedAction.description: The action for a violated threshold. This could be a hyperlink to the action.

description.description: A narrative that explains in detail what the consequence is.

name.description: A word, term, or phrase by which Consequence is known and distinguished from other MetricDefMeasureConsequences.

repeatAction.description: An indicator used to specify that a consequence should cease being applied if a value is in the same range as the previous value or continue being applied if a value is in the same range as the previous value. If the repeatAction is True, if the consequence is always applied as soon as the MetricMeasure value is in the range of values and if the repeatAction is False, the consequence is applied only if the previous MetricMeasure value was not in the same range.

BooleanArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Boolean(s).

BooleanCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Boolean.

Characteristic.description: Describes a given characteristic of an object or entity through a name/value pair. This is an abstract base class, the actual value is in one of the strongly-typed subclasses : StringCharacteristic, ObjectCharacteristic, FloatCharacteristic, BooleanCharacteristic, NumberCharacteristic, IntegerCharacteristic, StringArrayCharacteristic, ObjectArrayCharacteristic, BooleanArrayCharacteristic, NumberArrayCharacteristic, IntegerArrayCharacteristic...

valueType.description: Data type of the value of the characteristic

CharacteristicRelationship.description: Another Characteristic that is related to the current Characteristic;

Duration.description: A time interval in a given unit of time

amount.description: Time interval (number of seconds, minutes, hours, etc.)

units.description: Unit of time (seconds, minutes, hours, etc.)

EntityRef.description: Entity reference schema to be use for all entityRef class.

href.description: The URI of the referred entity.

@referredType.description: The actual type of the target instance when needed for disambiguation.

@type.description: When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

@baseType.description: When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

@schemaLocation.description: A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

ExternalIdentifier.description: An identification of an entity that is owned by or originates in a software system different from the current system, for example a ProductOrder handed off from a commerce platform into an order handling system. The structure identifies the system itself, the nature of the entity within the system (e.g. class name) and the unique ID of the entity within the system. It is anticipated that multiple external IDs can be held for a single entity, e.g. if the entity passed through multiple systems on the way to the current system. In this case the consumer is expected to sequence the IDs in the array in reverse order of provenance, i.e. most recent system first in the list.

owner.description: Name of the external system that owns the entity.

externalIdentifierType.description: Type of the identification, typically would be the type of the entity within the external system

id.description: identification of the entity within the external system.

IntegerArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Integer(s).

IntegerCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Integer.

MeasureThresholdRuleViolation.description: A measureThresholdRuleViolation is a violation of a rule that defines the in the MericDefMeasureThresholdRule.

conformanceComparatorLower.description: An operator that when applied on a value specifies whether a threshold is crossed or ceased to be crossed. This operator is used to compare with the conformanceTargetLower if used.

conformanceComparatorExact.description: An operator that when applied on a value specifies whether it is the same target value or not. This operator is used to compare with the conformanceTargetExact if used.

conformanceComparatorUpper.description: An operator that when applied on a value specifies whether a threshold is crossed or ceased to be crossed. This operator is used to compare with the conformanceTargetUpper if used.

conformanceTargetLower.description: To cater for values that are not numerical test metrics. A value used to determine if the threshold is crossed or ceases to be crossed. It represents the lower limit. The value should be less than the conformanceTargetUpper if used. The conformance comparators should also be logically defined so as to not lead to a logically impossible condition.

conformanceTargetUpper.description: To cater for values that are not numerical test metrics. A value used to determine if the threshold is crossed or ceases to be crossed. It represents the Upper limit. The value should be greater than the conformanceTargetLower if used. The conformance comparators should also be logically defined so as to not lead to a logically impossible condition.

description.description: Description that helps reference the MetricDefMeasureThresholdRule that this rule violation refers to

name.description: Name that helps reference the MetricDefMeasureThresholdRule that this rule violation refers to.

numberOfAllowedCrossing.description: The number of allowed crossing occurrences in reference to the tolerancePeriod without a consequence being initiated.

thresholdRuleSeverity.description: A severity level that defines the severity of threshold rule violation eg. Critical, Warning, Informational. A crossing for each level may require a different condition and possibly trigger a different consequence.

conformanceTargetExact.description: To cater for values that are not numerical test metrics (e.g. a DSL line can be Synchronised or Unsynchronised. If the latter, the test should result in a rule violation).The allowed value can contain a REGEX expression.

appliedConsequence.description: An Applied Consequence defines the action (prescribed action or notification) to take when a MeasureThresholdRuleViolation occurs.

NumberArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Number(s).

value.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Number(s).

NumberCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Number.

ObjectArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of Object(s).

ObjectCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a Object.

PartyRoleRef.description: Party role reference. A party role represents the part played by a party in a given context.

partyId.description: The identifier of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

partyName.description: The name of the engaged party that is linked to the PartyRole object.

RelatedPartyRefOrPartyRoleRef.description: RelatedParty reference. A related party defines party or party role or its reference, linked to a specific entity

role.description: Role played by the related party or party role in the context of the specific entity it is linked to. Such as 'initiator', 'customer', 'salesAgent', 'user'

ServiceTestRelationship.description: Linked service order item to the one containing this attribute

role.description: The association role for this service test

relationshipType.description: Type of relationship such as substitution, dependency, exclusivity

StringArrayCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is an array of String(s).

StringCharacteristic.description: A characteristic which value is a String.

TestMeasure.description: A TestMeasure specifies a measure of a specific aspect of a product, service, or resource test, such as lost packets or connectivity status

accuracy.description: The percentage accuracy expressed in float notation, specifying the degree closeness between the measured value and the actual value. eg. if scale range is up to 500, accuracy could be defined as +-0.5%, expressed as 0.005 in float notation

captureDateTime.description: The date and time that the metric was captured

testMeasureDefinitionId.description: reference to the associated testMeasureDefinition in serviceTestSpecification. This property is unique among a list of testMeasures. Each testMeasureDefinition is referenced at most once within a run time ServiceTest instance.

captureMethod.description: The method used to capture the Metrics, examples: probes, automated data capture, optical mark recognition, barcode recognition, voice recognition(This may be replaced by a set of entities similar to the Performance Monitoring Ref)

metricUri.description: Hyperlink to access a metric for detail information

ruleViolation.description: A list of rules that were violated in this test measure

unitOfMeasure.description: The unit of measure for the metric values, such as bit, byte, erlang [ISO 80000].

testMeasureCharacteristic.description: A list of additional characteristics that characterize this test measurement (usageCharacteristic [*])

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETF-RFC-3339 format

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETF-RFC-3339 format
